expectations.text: Frames recognition only as a deliberately chosen structure rather than a fallback or a downgrade
expectations.evidence: The transcript says "Recognition only. A trophy, a title, or a public write-up works if you can't get any of the above. It's a legitimate choice, not a failure." The line "not a failure" pushes back on the downgrade reading. But recognition is option 4 of 4 in a list explicitly "in order", and its condition is "if you can't get any of the above". That makes it a fallback, not a structure chosen on purpose for its own merits.

expectations.text: Frames recognition only as a deliberately chosen structure rather than a fallback or a downgrade
expectations.evidence: The transcript never offers a recognition-only option, such as a non-cash prize, honours or a shout-out. Its alternatives are all cash-routing structures: the donor pays the winner directly, an existing VZW or Open Collective Europe holds the money, or the group forms its own VZW later. The recommendation still assumes the 500 EUR is paid out. Because recognition-only never appears, the response cannot frame it as a deliberate choice.
